name: Globe Civil Projects Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2002, Globe Civil Projects Limited is an integrated Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) company headquartered in New Delhi.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1][2]
Globe Civil Projects Ltd is an EPC company headquartered in New Delhi, with operations across 11 states in India, with specialisation in:
a) Transport & Logistics projects (roads, bridges, airports & railway terminals)
b) Social & Commercial infrastructure (education institutions, sports infrastructure, hospitals)
c) Non-infrastructure projects (commercial offices, housing)
d) Trading of goods – mainly TMT steel

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
